responsibility: Implements the public C/C++ intrinsic header for the standard RISC-V scalar bit-manipulation extensions. It exposes inline wrappers or macros for Zbb, Zbkb, Zbc/Zbkc, and Zbkx operations such as clz/ctz/cpop, rotates, byte-reverse and bit-reverse, carryless multiply, and xperm, selecting RV32 versus RV64 forms and gating declarations on the appropriate predefined extension macros.
